name: main
_comment: ROM 0x2CD60..0xA6C70 loads directly after the boot BSS (vram - rom = 0x800369B0, derived by matching jal targets to function prologues). Last code at ~0x800D20A0, data to 0x800DD620, then BSS. bss_size is an estimate reaching ~0x80170000; refine once the game's DMA/segment table is found.
